problems.location: Physical p.9 / printed p.885 Assumption 1.3(a)-(e); physical p.11 / printed p.887 equation (3) and following mass chain; physical p.12 / printed p.888 bad-region mass conversion
problems.claim_refuted: Current mass outside fixed neighborhoods vanishes, and M(S_i)->Vol(N), under the literal geometric-volume assumptions.
problems.decisive_evidence: Connected smooth support N_i=N#S^3 with a remote radius i^-1 bubble carrying multiplicity i^3 and a radius i^-5 thin neck. Flat convergence and every explicit assumption hold, but remote mass tends to 2*pi^2.
problems.impact: A false auxiliary mass assertion and omitted multiplicity/mass hypothesis in the stated proof.
problems.impact_limit: The example does not refute Proposition 1.4 conclusion or either main theorem. Theorem 3.2 has D_i=[[N_i]], and Theorem 2.8 has minimizing mass and vanishing discarded mass.
problems.repair: State the intended unit-multiplicity condition, or impose adequate weighted mass convergence and audit area/curve-lifting estimates. Explicitly retain the application-specific mass control.
problems.severity_reason: Demonstrated defect is localized and repairable with control already present in the main applications; no core theorem counterexample or irreparable loss of a main implication established.

verification_limits.item: Core cited results checked at original statement and relevant proof-passage level; no recursive audit of every foundational reference.
The original Besson-Courtois-Gallot papers were not all acquired/read in full. Required real-hyperbolic matrix bound proved independently; detailed Song exposition and its applications checked.
Acquired arXiv/author/MPI versions are identified. No journal-byte equivalence for those references asserted. Publisher webpage denial not bypassed; public primary preprint acquired normally.
No claim of full ambient uniqueness, convergence of unmodified manifolds, or verification of unrelated rank-one extensions.

checked_non_problem_annotations.item: S^2 notation is interpreted as S^(n-1); frequency argument is dimension-independent.
Use shrinking sufficiently small collars for the local Lipschitz application, not an unneeded all-radii reading.
Inner-neighborhood buffer yields the required intrinsic-ball volume bound without an overstrong blanket ball inclusion.
Approximate endpoints, near-minimizing paths and finitely many bounded homotopy classes justify the strict-margin argument.

independent_acceptance.scope: Focused verification of the existing findings; no new whole-paper review

issue_results.result: Confirmed as an auxiliary hypothesis/proof overstatement; Minor retained.
issue_results.source_and_scope: Physical p9/printed885 Assumption1.3(a)-(e), p11/887 equation(3) and its mass chain, p12/888 the conversion of bad-region volume to mass. The preceding Lemma1.2 on p8 uses integral currents and does not impose a cycle or unit-multiplicity requirement. Geometric boundary area of N_i and current boundary mass are different quantities.
issue_results.independent_hypothesis_check: Take a connected closed oriented Riemannian3-manifold N, including a hyperbolic one if desired, E=N x R^4 with complete product metric, a remote radius r_i=i^(-1) sphere in a vertical fiber at distance about1, and a thin radius epsilon_i=i^(-5) neck to N x {0}. A framed4-dimensional handle of bounded length in dimension7 has filling volume O(epsilon_i^3) and side3-volume O(epsilon_i^2), with uniform smoothing estimates since epsilon_i/r_i tends to0. The connected closed smooth support N_i has the Riemannian length metric induced by the restricted ambient metric. Set S_i=[[N_i]]+(i^3-1)[[B_i]] on its punctured vertical spherical part.
issue_results.flat_and_map_check: The natural current difference is filled by the handle and sphere4-ball, of mass O(epsilon_i^3+r_i^4). The extra weighted punctured sphere has flat norm O(i^3(r_i^4+epsilon_i^3))=O(i^(-1)+i^(-12)), so S_i converges flatly to [[N x {0}]]. Product projection is smooth and1-Lipschitz for the actual restricted ambient metric. The natural component has degree1 and the vertical B_i projects to0, so its pushforward is exactly [[N]]. The unchanged open main region R_i is an exact isometry region with volume tending to Vol(N); its complement has volume O(i^(-3)+i^(-10)). Geometric boundary is empty, and even current boundary mass is O(i^(-7)).
issue_results.decisive_evidence: For fixed eta=1/4, the weighted bubble is outside O_eta eventually and has mass i^3(2pi^2 r_i^3-O(epsilon_i^3))->2pi^2. Thus the mass outside O_eta does not tend to0 and total mass tends to Vol(N)+2pi^2 despite unweighted support-volume convergence. All literal assumptions, connectedness and uniform mass/diameter bounds hold.
issue_results.counterevidence: If the currents were explicitly the canonical unit currents, this example would be excluded; that condition is not a consequence of a manifold support and is not in Assumption1.3. The limiting projection here is an isometry, so the example does not disprove Proposition1.4's conclusion. It demonstrates precisely the auxiliary equation and mass identification claimed in the report.
issue_results.core_application_and_calibration: At physical25/901 the entropy application explicitly defines D_i=[[N_i]]. At physical20-21/896-897 the spherical Plateau application has minimizing mass converging to Vol(M,g') and equation(20) controls discarded current mass. These extra controls exclude this example in the actual main uses. Minor rests on that demonstrated difference in hypotheses and verified application-specific mass control, not on a rule requiring an irreparable defect or a counterexample to the main theorem before Major is possible.
issue_results.repair_boundary: An explicit canonical-current condition repairs the unsupported volume-to-mass inference. A general weighted-current repair needs actual mass control and a recheck of the area and curve-lifting estimates. This acceptance does not claim a newly verified complete alternative proof, convergence of unmodified ambient spaces or full ambient uniqueness.
